record.name: Gladly
record.one_liner: Gladly API and App Platform for building integrations and automating workflows with customer service data.

auth.notes: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication where the password is the API token and the username is the agent email.

access.notes: Administrators can log in, navigate to Settings > Users, assign the API User permission, and create API tokens directly from the dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Exposes a REST API, Lookup API, webhooks, and Chat SDK.
